# BaDjR Tech

> BaDjR Tech is a small, fast-moving, AI-enabled software studio. We design and build beautiful custom websites, digital tools, SaaS platforms, white-label products, and bespoke software — delivered quickly and efficiently, without agency bloat. Our motto: AI-accelerated, technically backed. We use AI to move fast, but every line of code is reviewed, confirmed, and secured by a formally trained engineer.

## About

BaDjR Tech was founded in 2024 by Dakotah Jennifer and Alexander Backfish. We take on a small number of projects at a time so every client gets our full attention — no hand-offs to junior staff, no bloated process. Like our namesake, the badger, we dig beneath the surface to build things that last. We are AI-enabled but not AI-hype: speed from AI, quality from real computer science — so we stand behind every product we ship.

- Website: https://badjrtech.com
- Based in the United States
- Founded: 2024
- Positioning: Small, quick, efficient — we make beautiful things. AI-accelerated, technically backed.

## Founders

- **Dakotah Jennifer** — Co-Founder & CEO. Creative strategist and entrepreneur with a decade of experience in brand strategy, creative direction, lease-up marketing, fractional brand management, and data-driven content campaigns. Founder and CEO of DakJen Creative LLC; previously Chief Creative Officer at Northern Real Estate Urban Ventures. Holds an MFA in Creative Writing from Columbia University and a BA in English Literature, magna cum laude, from Washington University in St. Louis. Email: dakotah@badjrtech.com
- **Alexander Backfish** — Co-Founder & CTO. Full-stack software engineer with expertise across Angular, React, Next.js, Java Spring Boot, NestJS, PostgreSQL, serverless architecture, and AWS. Founder of Sword in Stone (SaaS). B.S. in Computer Science from Colorado State University Global. Based in Clayton, North Carolina. Email: alexander@badjrtech.com

## Services

- **Web Design & Development** — Custom websites built from scratch, fast, accessible, and crafted to convert. From marketing sites to complex web applications.
- **Digital Tools & SaaS** — Software that solves real problems. Dashboards, automation platforms, and internal tools built to scale.
- **White-Label Products & Services** — Ready-to-brand platforms and services companies can offer as their own. We build it, you label it.
- **Custom Tech Solutions** — Bespoke engineering for unusual workflow and product challenges.
- **Brand & UX Design** — Visual identity and user experience that makes a product feel coherent, considered, and impossible to imitate.
- **API & Integrations** — Connecting tools, automating workflows, and building the infrastructure that keeps a stack running smoothly.
- **Strategy & Consulting** — Product definition, stack choice, and roadmap building — including where AI APIs, AI-powered websites, and generative tools fit a business.
- **AI & Automation** — AI APIs, AI-powered websites, generative tools, intelligent assistants, and workflow automation built into products or operations.
- **AI Consulting** — Workflow audits, highest-ROI AI opportunity identification, tool pilots, and team training for practical AI adoption.

## How We Work

1. **Discover** — A focused discovery call and workflow audit.
2. **Design** — Wireframes and visual design with early, frequent client feedback.
3. **Build** — AI-accelerated engineering with human review on every line; weekly demos.
4. **Ship & support** — Launch, monitor, and ongoing improvement after day one.

## Selected Projects

- PanelList — End-to-end conference management platform: speaker submissions, scheduling, and attendee coordination.
- [Design Domain](https://www.designdomainllc.com/) — FF&E procurement and design for real estate projects.
- [GroundUp](https://community.drginamerritt.net) — Affordable housing development courses and community by Dr. Gina Merritt, built on 30+ years and $600M+ of real deals.
- [DJC Studio](https://studio.dakjencreative.com) — Learning platform for small business owners: masterclasses, 101s, and 1:1 Studio Sessions.
- [The Wren Club](https://www.thewrenclub.com/) — Membership community for women entrepreneurs.
